recaps.title: Mike sets the pace; every decimal counts
paragraphs: Week 3 belongs to Mike, who put up 179.95 points. Mike, JB remain unbeaten through 3 weeks. There is plenty of season left, but the scoreboard is already collecting receipts.
The closest finish: Coy edged Golly 131.30–130.60, a margin of 0.70. That is the kind of result that sends someone back through every lineup decision.
At the other end, Mike beat JT by 66.95, 179.95–113.00. No last-minute decimal rescue was coming for that one.
The biggest starter performance was Brock Purdy: 45.25 points for Mike. One monster score makes a great headline; the full lineup still has to finish the job. The next chapter is Week 4.
